clips.title: The story
paras: After the step with Lord Aliden Perenolde, Elysa gives up Taretha's pendant and asks only to be left in peace. You carry it back to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

Elysa has no wish to hold on to any memory of Lord Aliden Perenolde. You may take the pendant, Elysa says, and begs only that you then go in peace. It once belonged to Taretha Foxton, a childhood friend of Thrall's. You are to bring it to Krusk in Tarren Mill, so that it returns to the orcs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The pendant? Of course you can have it... Take it! I want no memory of him... Just please, please leave in peace...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've returned, friend. Success to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is strange that the Warchief would expend so much over such a small thing. I do not claim to understand him, but I will follow him, whatever his commands. You did well, friend, no doubt the Warchief will be glad to hear of your success.
